v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum * hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman * seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.la: Deus, ómnium largítor bonórum, qui in fámula tua Bibiána cum virginitátis flore martýrii palmam coniunxísti: mentes nostras eius intercessióne tibi caritáte coniúnge; ut, amótis perículis, prǽmia consequámur ætérna.
text.en: O God, the Giver of all good gifts, Who unto the lily of pure maidenhood in the hand of thy servant Bibiana, didst join the palm of a glorious martyrdom, grant us, we beseech thee, at her pleading, that our hearts and minds being joined to thee by thy love, we may escape all dangers which do presently beset us, and finally attain unto thine everlasting joy.

title.la: Feria IV infra Hebdomadam I Adventus
title.en: Feria IV infra Hebdomadam I Adventus

text.la: De Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;
